description: Land Title Settlement Department - Muppane, Monaragala D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720094 (24/0442)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including ownership details, property boundaries, and land classifications. The content focuses on land registrations, title settlements, and property ownership transfers, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
